Mystical Elf Lord 
"Halt! I know of your mission here. The Mystical Elves know the secrets of magic. We sympathize with your cause to unite and gather a strong Elven Alliance. However we have our own troubles. We Mystical Elves wish to be left alone."

Mystical Elf Lord 
"You will be attacked and viewed as an outsider like anyone else. Unless you win the confidence of my people. This dwelling before you has been taken over by a foul beast. Defeat this beast and we shall consider your offer."

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Very good! I am pleased that you were able to come out victorious. The Mystical Elves have heard of your victory here today. You have done well but you have not won our trust just yet!"

"Don't be such a fool! We need as many of our brethren on our side. The forces that conspire against us grows with each day! Do not leave us in purgatory. The Alliance marches forward and you must join us."

Mystical Centaur Charger 
" The Elven Alliance have arrived. The rumors are true then. You attempt to gather as many Elves to your secret cause! Our Elf ruin has been captured by troublesome oafs. This will be a test to see how formidable you are."

"Foolish Mystical Elves! Your arrogance will be the ruination of all of us. Do you not know the power of our enemies. The Empire, the Legions Of The Damned, the Mountain Clans and the servants of Mortis the Undead Hordes plot against us! Join us!"

Mystical Centaur Charger 
"The Alliance is formidable! I apologize for my arrogance. I will tell the others about the cause. I personally agree with joining the Alliance. However many among us do not and it will take action to win over our trust!"
"Very, well. We will win the trust of our mystical cousins. Though I hope we win it soon for I fear that our time is coming to an end!"

Dark Elf Gast 
"The fire in my head, the burning. My mind still stings from the savage touch of Mortis' magic! Join you, never, I...I will have you join us in our celebration to Mortis. My mind burns and only your sacrifice to Mortis will ease my pain!
"Foul creature! You shall know more than a slight sting in your head. The Alliance shall release you from your misery!"

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Impressive victory! That mad foul has been trouble for some time. Be warned though the Mystical Elves are do not trust outsiders. Even though who resemble us. Winning our loyalty will take effort!"
"We do not have time for this! Join us and share your secrets with us! The Empire are a worthy foe not to be taken lightly. We need your support! For our mutual survival we must join now!"

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Do not presume to tell me what I must and must not do! For all we know you can be a Doppelganger. We have heard that the Legions Of The Damned have those who can alter their appearance and abilities fooling their enemies!"

Duke 
"Foolish pathetic Elves! Prepare to be destroyed once and for all!"

Mystical Elf Centaur Charger 
"The Mystical Lair, was the center of our magics. Since that time it has been taken over by Cultists and a mysterious creature. Defeat this beast and we will give you some insight to our magics."
"Very well! Finally perhaps the Mystical Elves are seeing the light of reason! Only together can we defeat our common foes! The Alliance will once again be triumphant."

Mystical Centaur Charger  
"Thank you! You have done well! I have given you a spell. Use it wisely, I will tell the rest of your great work. I must let you know that others do not share my enthusiasm. I just want what is best for the Mystical Elves!"

"We must proceed with caution. The Legions Of The Damned are rumored to have left Doppelgangers' to blend into the crowds. These creatures have the ability to duplicate the appearance and abilities of others. Precaution must be taken always."

Cillen the Dryad 
"Thank you! We have been looking for the Ocean Charm for ages! The Mystical Elves fear that you are a Doppelganger and they do not trust you. I shall take the step and join the Elven Alliance!"

Mystical Elf Lord  
"Her death will not go unavenged. The Legions Of The Damned have murdered an important member of the Mystical Elves. We will exact our revenge upon you!"

"The Ocean Charm! With this special item we can win over the Mystical Elves and have them join the Alliance. I have heard that nearby in Ocean City, it's protector has been searching for the Ocean Charm."

Mystical Forest Elf 
"Halt! I know that you are not who you claim to be! You may appear to be Elves but you are Legions Of The Damned in disguise! I can see you for who you truly are. The Mystical Elves are not to be taken for fools!"

"Have you lost your senses! I am here to help you and the rest of the Elves. Join the Alliance and together we can forge ahead and create a future for ourselves. I am on your side whether you know it or not!"

Mystical Forest Elf 
"Lies! Like so many before you will turn on us! I know that you are a Doppelganger masquerading as an Elf. Prepare for battle!"

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Fools! You think that you can confuse us with your trickery! I saw you murder one of us! You cannot deny that I saw you murder him. I shall warn the rest of the Mystical Elves. You are not welcomed here, foul Doppelganger."

"Wait you fool! We only defended ourselves. This realm has gone mad with fear and paranoia. I assure you that we have only good intentions. The Elves must be united now more than ever. The Alliance is the future. Without us isolated tribes will perish."

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Very well! Against my better judgement I shall give you a chance. Be warned though you are being watched. If you should betray us I will see to it personally to your destruction."
"The Zymora Prison tower has an assortment of prisoners. I am sure that those not normally allied with one another will attack us in unison. Let us prepare for the worst."

Imperial Squire 
"Cursed Elves! We know of your unholy pact with the Legions Of The Damned! As we speak our diplomats are working on a truce with the Empire. United we will stand and drive you little creatures out once and for all!"

Doppelganger 
"Ha, ha, ha! The Alliance will never persuade the Mystical Elves to join you. As we speak others like myself are spreading lies about you and your intentions. We have been telling everyone  that the Alliance server Mortis!"

Weroc 
"My Liege, thank you for bringing the Holy Artifact. My mind sees everything so clearly now. The Doppelgangers have infiltrated many of our cities and convinced many of us that the Empire is evil. We must endure the worst."

"The Holy Artifact is once again ours! The nearby Imperial Sea City has reported that this item has gone missing. Withe Doppelgangers running around many will be suspicous of us. I hope that by returning this item will win some Imperials over."
"Through sacrifice our Elves have been able to call up a spirit that will heal us. All we have to do is come close to the Capital and we will be healed."
"Our wizards and priests have managed to pool their magic to heal our wounded. All we have to do is bring our wounded close to the capital and they shall be healed."

"The Legions Of The Damned will not rest until the realm is thrown into chaos. The Doppelgangers have infiltrated the Empire and are spreading lies about us. Anyone who crosses our path must fall. Regardless if they were once friends or not!"

"We are here to end this crisis. For some reason the Imperials within our Empire have decided to form their own faction. The Imperial Knights and Imperial Priests are to pay for their disruption to the Empire! We must restore order!"

Squire 
"My Leige, what of Doragons eye? We must retrieve the evil object and bring it to the capital. The Imperials will be dealt with but we must be first to find the eye!"

"Squire, you speak out of turn! I know of our mission. Doragon's eye will be found and secured at our capital. The Imperials however can prove to be a great distraction and if their heresy spreads they will hurt the stability of the Empire!"

Imperial Assassin 
"Your presence here only justifies our anger. We have heard of how the Empire plans to form an alliance with our enemies. As we speak our former Empire is making a pact with the Legions Of The Damned!"
"Lies, how dare you suggest such a vile pack! You are mistaken! We shall never sell our souls to the Legions Of The Damned!"

"The Imperial Sea City is nearby. The city is south behind the mountains. A quick journey to the city should prove most interesting. These Imperials must be stopped at all cost. The stability of the Empire depends on it."

Imperial Thief 
"This territory is denied to you. The Empire's presence here disturbs the Imperial Lords. We have learned of your sinister plot to sell us out to our enemies."
"Don't be such a fool! Never shall we deal with the Legions Of The Damned! The Empire is the light during these dark times! Stand aside before I send you to the afterlife myself!"

Imperial Thug 
"Fools! The Legions Of The Damned have already hung a dark cloud over the Empire. Our Wizards are preparing themselves at this moment. Your presence in our realm has angered them. Rightfully so!"

Mage 
"We shall attack once a week until vengeance is ours. This city belongs to the Imperial Empire and followers of the Legions Of The Damned will be defeated by our magic."

Imperials White Wizard 
"You dare step foot near our city! We have heard how you plot against us. Never shall we bow down to our enemies. Leave now before I am forced to strike you down."

"Watch yourself foul wizard. I am not in the mood to listen to your boasts. The Legions Of The Damned have poisoned this realm with their lies. Doppelgangers have hidden among us all. These foul wretched creatures are the one to blame!"

Imperial White Wizard 
"Silence! I will not be an audience to your lies!"
"We have to proceed with caution. Judging by the texture of this ground we may not be alone. Giant Black Spiders dwell in these conditions. Our presence will not go unnoticed."
"The Giant Black Spiders may still be lurking. I have the uneasy feeling that we are being watched. I may be paranoid but we can never be too careful!"
"Giant Black Spiders are know to harvest on travellers. Keep an eye out for them. This is their land and there are probably more than one Spider in the area."
"We must travel carefully. Spiders are all around us. I can hear them, they will feast upon us if we are not careful!"

Imperial Thug 
"Leave! The Wizard of Allantyr does not wish to fight. Lucky for you he is a passive man. In the name of the Imperial Empire you are to leave or you be defeated."

Mystical Elf Centaur Strider 
"I have heard of you. I am not convinced that you are whom you claim to be. The Doppelgangers have caused much damage without so much as raising a finger. I cannot allow you passage."

Shamaness 
"We barbarians are mighty! I can easily defeat! Our Barbarian Tower has been taken over. Defeat those within it and I shall serve your cause and help defeat your enemies."

Shamaness 
"I am indebted to your cause. Thank you for defeating the Marsh dwellers."

Lizard Man 
"Helllpp usss and I will join your caussse! The Marsh Ruin hassss been taken over. Defeat the Demon Lord and I sssshall aid you on your quessst."

Lizard Man 
"Victorrrry! I will join your causse and together we shhalll know victorrrrry!"

Sage 
"I believe in the cause of the Elven Alliance. More Mystical Elves agree with the Alliance in secret. They are just too terrified to openly join. I have taken the first step and I give my life to the Alliance."

Guardian 
"We are at war! I throw my support behind the Elven Alliance. Only together can we be triumphant!"

Arch-Angel 
"I finally see the truth. Doppelgangers sent from the Legions Of The Damned have been poisoning our minds. I will once again serve the glory of the Empire!"

Ranger 
"The Legions Of The Damned will pay for this treachery! I have learned that the Elven Alliance are in league with the Doppelgangers. The Mystical Elves do not trust the Alliance either. Our enemies surround us!"

Imperial Priest 
"Foul followers of the Damned! You will not defeat the Imperial Empire. We have fought too long to let our brothers sell us out to the dark forces. Leave now or I will be forced to attack. Consider this your only warning!"

Imperial Ranger 
"Long live the Imperial Empire! Hostile creature you have done well. Already through our rebellious faction we here the whispers. That it is not the Empire but the Legions Of The Damned who are behind a sinister plot to divide us."

Imperial Ranger 
"I have heard the whispers and I do not believe them. The Witch-Hunters have always be evil in my eyes. It is they who have convinced the Empire to sell their souls to the Legions Of The Damned! We Imperials will fight to the death!"

Bandit 
"Our mission in this realm is not an easy one. We must find Doragon's Eye and return it to our capital. Along the way we will encounter hostile forces. We must endure for the sake of the Alliance."

Archmage 
"The Imperial Empire has gone mad. Despite their aggression against us. We must find Doragon's Eye and bring that evil artifact to our Capital. We can ill afford to let the Imperials interfere with our plans!"

"The markings on this ruin are strange. I can make out some of its writing. I think that it says that Doragon's eye will provide additional strength to its guardian. Strange the eye is protecting its guardian. Retrieving the eye will not be easy."

"The writing on this ruin is from an old rare language. I can only make out small bits of it. I think it reads that Doragon's Eye will protect its guardian. The protecter will be stronger than it normally should be. This Quest will not be easy!"

"The Whirl Pool! That is the source of the magic in these waters. A dying Archmage told me that the Mystical Elves draw their power from this whirlpool. A battle between two dragons ended in devastation. They were fighting for something powerful."

"The dragons battled the defeat dragon died where the whirlpool is. Its magic devastated the region causing the seaway to cave into itself. Now years later its magic slowly resonates through the realm. Our wounded will be healed near the whirlpool."

"The whirlpool is the source of the mystical magic surrounding all of us. Our cousins the Mystical Elves draw their magic upon this whirlpool. Eons ago two dragons battled over this seaway. The defeated dragon's death cry was devastating."

"The realm was devastated and the waterway collapsed upon itself. As time has gone by the magic slowly releases itself through the realm. Our wounded will be healed by this whirl pool. Let us find Doragon's Eye and end this madness."

Guardian 
"I swear allegiance to the Alliance. Our enemies gather against us. Both the Mystical Elves and others plot our destruction. Only together can the Alliance endure!"

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Do not dare attempt to recruit any of the Mystical Elves to your doomed Alliance! Consider this a warning!"

Bandit 
"Do not listen to that fool! He is frightened because the Elves in a nearby city wish to join the Alliance. The city Villosburg has been divided by those who support us and those who support the Mystical Elves."

Virgile  
"Thank you for destroying that lair. I can see that it was foolish of me to leave the Empire. I serve only in the interests of the great Empire."

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Fool! You have shown us nothing but disrespect. Your arrival will be the ruination of the Mystical Elves and I will not stand by and watch you slaughter my people!"

Mystical Oracle Elf 
"Your might was too much for us on this day! We surrender this city!"
"We are far off the trail! If we are to find Doragon's eye we must continue our search. This city will be useful if our people are weak and need to rest."

Mystical Centaur 
"Your presence here threatens the Mystical Elves future! You have taken this city and I suspect that you will try to lure away more Elves to your ill fated Alliance! We will resist!"

Mystical Elf Guardian 
"Doragon's Eye is protected! I fear that you are not yet powerful enough to take on the Eye's guardian."

Doppelganger 
"The Legions Of The Damned have sent us to infiltrate the region. You may have defeated me! However there are more Doppelgangers in the realm, spreading lies and creating confusion."

Spiritess 
"Doragon's Eye is protected by a powerful guardian. If you should confront its protector use the Water Wards to give you an edge!"

Death Knight 
"You have fought well. This city is yours! Bewarned that the Undead Hordes will rise to fight on another day!"

Grenzador Mage 
"We bow down to your dominance. This city is no longer ours. Doragon's Eye is protected by a powerful creature. If you are to retrieve the eye you must be prepared for an epic battle."

Grenzador Mage 
"I fear that I must warn you. By taking over this city you have focuses the Mage Order's anger on you. In time Wizards will appear. You have been warned."

Cultist  
"As we speak, Doppelgangers are running throughout the realm. Paranoia and fear will run through making a mockery of order. Mystical Elves battling Elves, Empire vs Imperial Empire. Everything has gone according to plan."

Cultist 
"Your victory here today is impressive. Sadly it is not enough for you to win the day! The Eye that we seek is guarded by a powerful beast! There is an artifact which will paralyze its enemies. Find that artifact and you may survive!"

Lich Queen 
"Brave ssssoulsss! You have besssted me on thisss day! To find Doragon's Eye you will need to look where the water flows into the whirl pool!"

Shamaness 
"The great eye of Doragon that you seek is well guarded. Our water wards will protect you briefly. If you seek the eye you will need to use these wards or you will die!"

Mystical Elf Lord 
"Fool! The Empire now has Doragon's Eye if you do not hurry they will bring it to their Capital! Find the Eye or all is lost!"

Imperial Priest 
"Foolish Empire! The Elven Alliance now are now in possession of Doragon's Eye! Find it before they bring the Eye to their capital!"

Imperial Priest 
"The Imperial Empire will not surrender. Those closest to us in the Empire have sold our souls to the Legions Of The Damned!"

Occultist 
"On this day you have bested me. The Occult will live on. I am bound to tell you the secrets of the Eye. The beast that guards the Eye has been here for eons. The dragon is powerful and you will need the Water Wards to briefly protect you."

Imperial Priest 
"Sinners against the Imperial Empire will suffer great pain! You have taken this city from us! Know that you will not be able to retrieve Doragon's Eye from its powerful guardian!"

Imperial Apprentice 
"We have fallen to you on this day. I shall tell you all that I know. Our Imperial Priest has been hearing voices. He believes it to be from a higher source. The Priest has declared that the Empire is in league with our enemies!"

Imperial Ranger 
"I do not believe how easily we were defeated. You are a worthy adversary. I pray for you that you are durable enough to confront the Eye's protector."

Thug 
"There is word that the Legions Of The Damned are going to arrive. Personally I was in it for the gold, I don't care if the Empire is corrupt or not!"

Imperial Mage 
"The Elves and the Mystical Elves are forming an Alliance. If you are not careful you will be conquered by the Elven Alliance."

Woterim  
"I am honored bound to serve the cause of the victor. You have captured my city in exchange for sparing my life, I shall serve you!"

Duke 
"Fools! I have been cursed to serve my enemies. The Mystical Elves must have caste a spell on me to serve you!"

Orc 
"Doragon's Eye guarded by beast that defeated many Orcs and Cyclops!"
Everything I possess is for sale.
My soldiers are the most formidable in the land.
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
How may I help you stranger?
The greatest fighters of the realm have trained here.
We will join your army, for a price.
My spells are the most potent in the region.

How may I help you stranger?
I have potent spells at a reasonable price.
My items are the best in the realm.
I will train your units for a price.
My captured animals are trained to fight on your behalf.
I will train your units for a price.
My wares can help you in your quest.
Come in, I will make worthy fighters out of your frail soldiers.
You'll be cutting a swathe through the land in no time.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.
